note: Builtins that take a leading localClientNum on the client VM. Client scripts run one VM per splitscreen client, so a client-side builtin acting on a particular screen takes the client index first: VisionSetNaked( 0, "vampire_low" ) against the server form VisionSetNaked( "vampire_low" ). The GSC library therefore under-declares these by one parameter when reused for CSC, and this list is what the CSC generation step corrects.
provenance: Derived by ClientArityHarvestTests from this game's own shipped client scripts, not hand-written: every .csc call to a name the GSC library knows was measured against the declared overloads, and a name kept when at least 80% of its over-supplied calls lead with a 0-3 literal or an argument spelled like a client index. That rule scores 31/31 with no false positives against BO3, the one game shipping a hand-documented client library to check it on. Regenerate the evidence with the harvest; edit here to record a name the corpus could not settle.
